caption: The drawing depicts a single circular plate rendered in grayscale, positioned centrally against a plain, light background. The plate has a broad rim with embossed lettering that reads "IN REMEMBRANCE OF ME" circling the upper and lower portions of the rim, with the words spaced evenly and capitalized in a stylized, curving font. There is also a small cross-like symbol on the lower section of the plate's rim. The interior of the plate is shaded with darker and lighter gray tones, creating the appearance of depth and a reflective surface. The composition is symmetrical, with the plate occupying most of the vertical center of the page.
title: Silver Communion Plate
